scope: Local paired development benchmark of the warm production reranker adapter on frozen retrieval candidates. Documents are English scientific abstracts. No answer generation, database, vector search or paid provider requests.

sample.rule: Sort all 809 official train IDs by SHA-256 of UTF-8 salt + ':' + ID. First 128 for paired measurement; next 4 distinct queries warm both arms. Each sequence is independent of text, labels, scores and timing.
sample.candidate_identity: Historical development baseline selection stage in original fusion order. Recover source text from public corpus using recorded revision UUID, 1200-character windows and 200-character overlap; every candidate logical chunk ID must match exactly.

arms.baseline: BgeReranker.rerank at the pinned commit. Tokenize and pad sequential batches in original candidate order.
arms.candidate: Same local BGE tokenizer and FP16 weights; tokenize each pair once, group by exact encoded length, restore logits to original candidate positions.

timing: In a single process, share the already loaded model and tokenizer. Shuffle an equal count of A-first/B-first pairs, concurrency one. Synchronize CUDA on both sides of each timed adapter call; include tokenization, padding, CPU-GPU transfers, forwards, restored logits. Exclude disk, warmup, sorting, annotations and bootstrap. Record p50/p95, paired mean and order strata.
quality: Use production ordering (-logit, -fusion_score, chunk_id). nDCG@10 deduplicates documents before cutoff. Consumer recall takes the first 5 raw chunks before document deduplication. Compare top1 chunk, top5/top10 chunk sets and order, all 20 scores, and which judged sources were available in the frozen 20. Count any failed query in the registered cohort and invalidate acceptance.
token_diagnostics: Record actual model input tensor shapes outside wall-clock measurement to count real and padded tokens. Require the same count of real tokens and scored pairs in each arm.

bootstrap.grouping: Connected components of full train queries sharing at least one positive source, resampled with replacement on the selected queries. Query-weighted paired means; percentile interval.

decision: All gates must pass to support this adapter on this measured workload. An incomplete run or failed gate does not qualify. No tuning or sample enlargement based on results; the public test split, other held-out labels and answer generators are excluded.
